text:
Alex Chen: Morning — trying to lock down the RFC review sync for tomorrow. Need to assign authors to slots, confirm reviewers, and make sure pre-reads are up. Can people take these slots? 3pm, 3:20pm, 3:40pm (30m block total).
Maria Gonzales: I can take 3pm. I'll volunteer to present the model-routing RFC :+1:
Jonathan Park: 3:20pm works for me. I can review kv-cache and give quick comments.
Samir Patel: I have a clash at 3:40 but can push. If needed I can do 3:40 after all. Also can review rollout-policy.
Lisa Nguyen: I can't do 3pm (customer calls) but can join 3:20 for q/a. I can pre-read the rollout-policy now.
Alex Chen: Great — tentative order: 1) model-routing (Maria) 2) kv-cache (Jon) 3) rollout-policy (Samir). Maria will have 12 mins + 3 for q's, Jon 12 + 3, Samir 12 + 3. Keep tight.
rfc-bot: Calendar event created: "RFC roundtable — 3x12" at 2026-03-18T15:00Z. Attendees: Alex Chen, Maria Gonzales, Jonathan Park, Samir Patel, Lisa Nguyen. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/xyz
Maria Gonzales: Thanks. I'll drop the pre-read link here: https://git.redwood.com/rfcs/model-routing/overview.md
Jonathan Park: kv-cache doc: https://git.redwood.com/rfcs/kv-cache/README.md — I've added a short changelog to the top.
Samir Patel: rollout-policy draft: https://git.redwood.com/rfcs/rollout-policy/draft.md — note the canary section is WIP.
Alex Chen: Please add short 'ask' lines at top of each RFC (what you want feedback on). Makes meeting way faster.
Lisa Nguyen: Done — I added a 3-line 'ask' for rollout-policy.
Maria Gonzales: Added 'ask' + tl;dr. Also added perf numbers to appendix.
Jonathan Park: FYI I'll call out a specific regression test; saved in the doc.
Alex Chen: Cool. Action items: Maria update doc by EOD, Jon prepare 2 quick slides, Samir finish canary section. I'll send final agenda ~1hr before.
Samir Patel: I'll aim to finish the canary section in the next 4h.
Alex Chen: @Lisa can you take notes? We'll capture decisions + follow-ups in the RFCs and update milestones.
Lisa Nguyen: Yup, happy to take notes. I'll post minutes in #eng after the sync.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. If you can't make your slot, ping here asap so we can reshuffle. :rocket:
